Select: compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Source: molecule_dictionary, molecule_hierarchy, compound_structures, compound_records, docs, activities, assays, target_dictionary. Join: molecule_dictionary parent to molecule_hierarchy on parent_molregno. molecule_hierarchy child to molecule_dictionary on molregno. child to compound_structures on molregno. child to compound_records on molregno. compound_records to docs on doc_id. compound_records to activities on record_id. activities to assays on assay_id. assays to target_dictionary on tid. Filter: parent chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1336'. target chembl_id = 'CHEMBL279'. standard_type = 'IC50'. standard_units = 'nM'. Sort: compound_chembl_id, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Limit: None.
